items.title: Robinhood expands AI agentic trading with automation and 24/7 cycle
items.summary: The 8:30 Hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley break down Robinhood's (HOOD) unveiling of its AI agentic trading features, including automated strategies and 24-hour markets, and assess whether these are safe spaces for unaccredited investors.

items.title: Micron reports earnings, PCE estimates and ADP employment report: What to Watch
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton takes a closer look at the top stories for investors to watch on Wednesday, Sept. 30, including Micron (MU) reporting earnings, Personal Consumption Expenditure estimates, and the ADP September employment report.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Micron Earnings Crush Views, S&P 500 At Critical Level As Treasury Yields Rise
items.summary: The Nasdaq faded while the S&P 500 fell to its 50-day as Treasury yields keep running. Micron earnings easily beat views.

items.title: U.S. stock futures rise following upbeat Micron earnings
items.summary: Investing.com-- U.S. stock index futures rose on Wednesday evening as bumper earnings from memory chip major Micron helped reinforce the artificial intelligence trade and spurred gains in broader tech stocks.
